name: Nirei Nagi
source:
A transfer student who comes into the protagonist's class.
He's a blunt realist who seems to hate women, but when he talks to other guys he seems a little friendlier.
Because of some misunderstanding between him and the protagonist on the day he transferred in their relationship is like cats and dogs.
He's always listening to music on his earphones.
